## Proposed glossary term

Thanks for helping to grow the [advISO Glossary of Terms](https://adviso-glossary.readthedocs.io/en/latest/glossary.html)! Please complete as many sections as you can. A maintainer will help refine the wording before the term is added.

Before you start, please search the [existing glossary](https://adviso-glossary.readthedocs.io/en/latest/glossary.html) and open issues to check the term isn't already covered or proposed.

---

### Term
*The term as it should appear in the glossary heading. Include any common abbreviation in brackets, e.g. Measurement uncertainty (MU).*


### Source standard(s)
*Standard(s) or reference documents where the term is defined or used, with clause numbers where possible, e.g. ISO 15189:2022 clause 7.3.4.*


### Definition (ISO / wet-lab context)
*A concise definition as used in ISO 15189 / ISO 17025. ISO standards are copyrighted, so please paraphrase rather than copying definitions word for word.*


### Example usage (wet-lab)
*One sentence showing the term used in a laboratory context.*


### Does the meaning change in bioinformatics?
- [ ] Yes, the meaning differs and needs a bioinformatics translation
- [ ] No, the definition applies as above (bioinformatics example only)
- [ ] Not sure

### Bioinformatics translation
*How the term should be understood for pipelines, software, reference data or compute infrastructure. Leave blank if the definition applies as above.*


### Example usage (bioinformatics)
*One sentence showing the term used in a bioinformatics context.*


### Ontological references (optional)
*Matching terms from ontologies such as MeSH, NCIT, OBI, SIO, PATO or OBCS.*


### Related glossary terms (optional)
*Existing entries this term should cross-reference or be distinguished from.*


### Why should this term be added? (optional)
*E.g. a common source of confusion between wet-lab and bioinformatics teams.*


---

### Checklist
- [ ] I have searched the existing glossary and open issues, and this term is not already covered.
- [ ] Definitions are written in my own words and do not reproduce copyrighted text.
- [ ] I am happy for this content to be edited and published as part of the advISO Glossary of Terms.
